units.source_text: 阿民以一个女人的力量支撑全家的生计。

en.t: Amin supported the livelihood of the whole family with the strength of one woman.

units.source_text: 无疑，这肯定是来自“为了儿子阿广”的这个决心。

en.t: Without doubt, this must have come from her resolve to do it for her son Ahiro.

units.source_text: 但是，也可能是因为阿广是从偏僻的为地方迁居到这一代的“外地人”的女儿，那种根植在她内心深处的基因的力量。

en.t: But it may also have been the power of the bloodline rooted deep within her, the daughter of outsiders who had moved to this generation from a remote place.

units.source_text: 阿住多次从邻居阿婆那里听说——

en.t: Azumi had heard this many times from the old woman next door:

units.source_text: “你们家阿民的力量真的跟她的外表很不相称啊，上次看到她扛着四大把的稻子从我面前走过去。”

en.t: The strength of your Amin really does not match her appearance; the other day I saw her walk past me carrying four big bundles of rice stalks.
